status: UTC timestamp construction and Gregorian calendar component; production integration, RFC3339, serde formatting and Local timezone conversion are separate gates.

compiler.bootstrap: Explicit Python B0, followed by native HIA B1, B2, B3 and component compilation.

entry.signature: u64 f0(const u8* source, u64 source_len, u8* output, u64 output_capacity, u8* workspace, u64 workspace_len)
entry.status_encoding: Core u32 zero extended to u64 by the fixed native borrowed-buffer wrapper.

caller_preconditions: Advertised source and output ranges are live for the synchronous call, readable for source and writable for output.
Source and output ranges do not overlap, including exact aliasing. Source is not concurrently modified.
No alignment is required. Lengths are actual allocated capacities; invalid pointers or invented capacities are outside the contract.
Zero-length workspace is never read or written. Native retains no pointers and has no mutable global state.

source.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed seconds use two's-complement bits

output.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed values use two's-complement bits

fields.name: valid
fields.value: 1 for a valid constructor result; otherwise 0

fields.name: year
fields.value: signed Gregorian year when valid; otherwise 0

output.tail: All bytes after offset 64 remain unchanged. Errors leave the entire output unchanged.

semantics.leap_nanoseconds: 1000000000 <= nanoseconds < 2000000000 only when Euclidean seconds modulo 60 equals 59
semantics.leap_second_rules: Match the original constructor, including leap fractions on the last second of any minute. Do not apply an external leap-second table or normalize the fraction.
semantics.calendar: Proleptic Gregorian calendar, including year zero and negative years, with floor division across negative days and 400-year eras.
semantics.invalid_values: Return success with [1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]; never saturate, wrap an invalid timestamp into range, or trap.

status_precedence.condition: output capacity is less than 64; checked before source/workspace frame validation
source length is not 64, workspace length is nonzero, version is not 1, operation is not 0, or any reserved word is nonzero
valid frame; exactly 64 output bytes are written for either a valid or invalid timestamp

differential_corpus.boundary_controls: Unaligned buffers, both zero and nonzero fills, exact and excess capacity, all shorter output capacities, truncated/oversized frames, invalid metadata and nonempty workspace; compare all bytes and surrounding guards.
